messages:
margo: Quick sync proposal  we need a tight contract for client-facing error hints from routing decisions (degrades, fallbacks, quota). Short, machine-readable, and safe.

sam: Agree. minimal surface pls.

margo: Draft payload idea: ```json
{
  "code": "route_degraded",
  "message": "Serving at reduced capacity",
  "client_hint": "retryable_transient",
  "retry_after_ms": 200
}
```

lee: +1. Keep telemetry-only fields out of response. Add route_reason and fallback_variant in traces only.

nora: Also enforce enum for client_hint (retryable_transient, quota_exhausted, client_error, terminal_failure, fallback_suggestion). No freeform.

emily: Console wants: per-route counts, last 50 samples (scrubbed), and a suggested SDK snippet next to badge.

sam: On HTTP semantics: map buckets to codes: retryable_transient -> 503, quota_exhausted -> 429, client_error -> 4xx, terminal_failure -> 5xx. Document it in the RFC.

ci-bot: CI check: lint/api-contracts passed for schema refs.

margo: Action items: margo -> RFC with exact schema + mapping table; lee/sam -> SDK helpers + tests; emily -> console mockups with tenant filter + scrub rules; nora -> telemetry tagging and scrub checklist. Draft by EOD Friday.

sam: Security note: scrub any user text and strip tokens near PII before showing samples.

margo: Thanks. I'll include sample SDK snippet and a tiny compatibility section for older clients. :thumbsup:
